text: Hello and welcome to the live commentary of the Premier League clash between Arsenal and Fulham at the Emirates Stadium.
Arsenal are looking to maintain their perfect start to the season after winning their opening two games of the campaign.
Mikel Arteta's men were forced to dig deep against Crystal Palace on Monday after Takehiro Tomiyasu was sent off early in the second half.
The Gunners held out to secure the win courtesy of Martin Odegaard's penalty, and will now be looking for a third win on the bounce in their contest with the Cottagers.
Fulham opened their campaign with a 1-0 win on the road over Everton, but were pegged back last time out against Brentford on a day to forget for Marco Silva and his team.
Tim Ream was sent off as the Bees left Craven Cottage with a 3-0 win as Bryan Mbeumo and Yoane Wissa got on the scoresheet.
Fulham need to hit back, but have lost the presence of Aleksandar Mitrovic following his move to Al Hilal.
Goals could now be an issue for the Cottagers this season and especially today.
Arsenal have made two changes to their side that beat Palace last time out.
Kiwior comes into the side to replace the suspended Tomiyasu at left-back.
Nketiah drops to the bench in the final third for Trossard, who forms a three-man front line with Saka and Martinelli.
Jesus returns to the bench after missing the opening two matches due to injury.
Fulham also make two changes from their defeat to Brentford in their last outing.
Bassey gets the nod to replace the suspended Ream in the heart of the back four.
Palhinha returns to fitness in the middle of the park as he replaces Reed, who drops to the bench.
Arsenal have never lost a home league game against Fulham, winning 24 and drawing six of their 30 such meetings.
It's the most one team has faced another at home without ever losing in English league history.
We're under way at the Emirates Stadium.

GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!!! PEREIRA POUNCES ON A MISTAKE FROM SAKA TO SCORE!!!!!! 1-0!!!!!! Saka plays an offload straight to Pereira, who takes on an early strike and catches Ramsdale off balance to find the back of the net.
Saka is loose with his pass back towards White and Pereira seizes on the ball.
He looks to chip Ramsdale off his line, and although he doesn't connect cleanly with his effort, it finds the bottom-left corner as the Arsenal keeper stumbles.
Pereira scored after just 0:57, the fastest goal in the Premier League this season.
WIDE! Martinelli collects Odegaard's cross-field pass and cuts in from the left flank to fire at goal.
He curls an effort towards the far corner that drifts wide of the target.
Wilson is almost in behind the Arsenal defence down the right flank, but the offside flag goes up late against the winger.
Arsenal are looking for the switch to the left flank for Martinelli early and often.
Tete holds his composure to halt his run on this occasion.
CHANCE! Saka forces a cross into the middle for Havertz to attack, but he cannot force his effort goalwards amid pressure from Diop.
The goal was gaping for the Germany international.
White sends an early ball over the top for Havertz to chase, but the ball takes a favourable Fulham bounce into the hands of Leno.
SAVE! Lukic loses out to Partey and he feeds Trossard in the middle of the park.
The forward finds Martinelli on the left flank and he cuts inside to fire at goal, only to see his effort saved by Leno.
Saka combines with Rice down the right flank and fires the ball across the face of goal, but Havertz is on his heels and fails to convert the opening.
SCRAMBLE! A corner from Odegaard pinballs around the Fulham box, but the visitors hold firm with important blocks to deny Martinelli.
Jimenez brings down Saka with a loose challenge and goes into the book.
BLOCK! Saka tries to catch out Leno with a low curling strike from the resulting free-kick, but Robinson is well placed to divert it over the top.
CLOSE! Jimenez almost extends Fulham's lead with a brilliant scissor kick at goal, but the ball drifts inches wide of the target.
White fails to clear a hopeful ball forward from Pereira and allows Jimenez to connect with his acrobatic attempt that just misses.
De Cordova-Reid breaks on the counter for the visitors and feeds Jimenez, who sees his effort deflected wide of the target for a corner.
Pereira's corner pinballs around the Arsenal box and several white shirt fling boots at the loose ball, but no one can connect to force Ramsdale into action.
WIDE! Wilson collects Pereira's offload after a mistake by Saliba.
He is afforded space and time, but his left-footed strike creeps just wide of the right post.
Rice has to be alert in the middle of the Arsenal box to direct Wilson's low ball from the right flank away from Pereira.
SAKA MISSES A SITTER! The forward should level the scores as he latches onto Trossard's deep cross from the left flank at the back post, but he nods his effort into the ground and over the bar.
SAVE! Saka wins the ball back high up the pitch and Arsenal swarm forward.
Trossard sends Martinelli into the inside-left channel and he fires low and hard towards the bottom-left corner.
Leno reads the danger and makes a solid stop.
Arsenal have conceded inside the first minute in three of their last nine Premier League matches at the Emirates Stadium (vs Bournemouth, Southampton and Fulham).
Arsenal are playing a very high line and it's handing Fulham a lot of space to hit on the break.
Saliba has to make an important challenge to nip in ahead of Pereira.
Fulham are denying Arsenal space through the middle and are forcing them wide into the channels.
It's all on Martinelli and Saka for the hosts.
Odegaard has the ball in the back of the net with a fine finish, but the goal is disallowed for offside against Havertz in the build-up.
The German was well beyond the last man.
SAVE! Saka works the ball back to Odegaard to unleash a strike at goal from 25 yards that Leno watches safely into his hands.
Robinson slips to allow Saka to break into the box, but Palhinha is on guard to fend off Saka and concede only a corner.
There will be two minutes of added time.
HALF-TIME: ARSENAL 0-1 FULHAM
Fulham are 45 minutes away from securing their first win on the road against Arsenal after taking a 1-0 lead into the break in their Premier League clash.
Andreas Pereira fired the Cottagers ahead after 57 seconds capitalising on a mistake from Bukayo Saka.
The Gunners pressed for an equaliser through Gabriel Martinelli and Martin Odegaard, but the visitors held firm at the back to frustrate the Gunners.
Arsenal seemed to be affected by their early lapse and were perhaps guilty of trying too hard in the final third to craft out the perfect chance.
The Gunners have had plenty of possession, but have lacked a clinical edge.
Fulham have looked dangerous on the break and are a threat to get a second that would take the contest away from the hosts.
Trossard makes way for Nketiah at the break for the hosts.
We're back under way in the rain at the Emirates Stadium.
SAVE! Saka twists and turns down the right flank and opens up space for a strike that Leno holds with strong hands.
Saka causes further problems down the right flank and forces a low ball across the face of goal, but there's no one there to convert the opening.
Bassey goes into the book for time-wasting for the visitors.
WIDE! Havertz gives the ball away and it allows Fulham to break forward with pace.
De Cordova-Reid cuts inside to shoot on his right foot, but sends his effort wide of the right post.
Havertz's poor game continues for the Gunners as he is caught offside in the final third.
The German has had real problems with his rhythm today.
Partey is withdrawn by Arteta for Zinchenko, which will slide all the defenders slide one place across.
So, White will operate at right-back.
Havertz has had a poor afternoon and is now replaced by Vieira.
Odegaard lines up a blast from distance and his effort travels at pace towards goal, but Leno watches it all the way into his hands.
CHANCE! White releases Odegaard into the inside-right channel and he cuts back to shoot on his left foot, only to lift his effort over the top.
Pereira is down on the field for the visitors and requires treatment.
He may have to make way here.
Cairney replaces the goalscorer Pereira in the Fulham midfield.
Nketiah and Martinelli both send cutbacks into the middle from the right and left, but Lukic gets back to make an important clearance ahead of Vieira.
Lukic brings down Zinchenko on the charge and goes into the book.
PENALTY TO ARSENAL! Tete lunges in on Vieira with a reckless challenge in the box.
The referee has an easy decision to make and points to the spot.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! SAKA CONVERTS!!!! Saka takes the ball instead of Odegaard, who scored from the spot on Monday, but has no problem converting from 12 yards.
He is forced to wait for a VAR check and a complaint by the referee for the ball placement on the spot.
However, he nails his left-footed strike into the bottom-right corner.
Arsenal are level.
Lukic is withdrawn from the Fulham midfield and is replaced by Reed.
Wilson makes way for Traore on the right flank.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! NKETIAH FIRES ARSENAL AHEAD!!!!!! 2-1!!!!! Nketiah scores, but Fulham are furious as Bassey is down on the field while the goal is scored.
Bassey is involved in a tussle with Saka that leaves him on the deck.
Arsenal play on as Vieira sends a pinpoint cross into the box from the left flank that Nketiah steers past Leno with an outstretched boot.
Vieira fires a perfect low cross into the Fulham box for Nketiah to convert with a fine finish.
Rodak is booked on the bench for the visitors in his appeal to the fourth official about Nketiah's goal.
Silva is furious on the bench and is shown a yellow card by referee Paul Tierney.
Arsenal have turned the game on its head, and it's Vieira who has made the decisive impact from the bench.
Saka tries to bundle his way past Robinson and Bassey in the inside-right channel, but the Cottagers do enough to halt his progress.
Leno takes a risk on the edge of his own box gathering a bouncing ball that almost drags him out of his area.
The keeper remains just inside his box.
Odegaard releases Nketiah in the Fulham half and he looks for the run of Martinelli in behind.
Diop is alert to make a vital interception.
OFF! Bassey blocks off Nketiah on a counter and collects his second yellow card and then a red.
He was already walking off after the challenge.
Jorginho replaces Odegaard in the Arsenal midfield for the closing stages.
Traore surges down the right flank and wins a corner for the visitors off the legs of Rice.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! PALHINHA EQUALISES!!!!!!!!!!! 2-2!!!! Fulham equalise late in the game through a fine finish from Palhinha.
Reed swings a perfect cross into the box from the right flank that evades the first Arsenal defender.
Palhinha strikes the ball first-time on his right foot and sends it away from Ramsdale into the bottom-left corner.
Reed angles a corner into the box from the right flank for Palhinha to shoot first-time and score.
De Cordova-Reid makes way for Adarabioyo to shore up the back for the visitors.
There will be nine minutes of added time.
Nketiah probes in the final third and cuts inside, but his effort is charged down by the Fulham rearguard.
Jesus replaces Rice for stoppage time.
Vieira is offside as he connects with a perfect overhead kick at the back post.
It was saved anyway, but it was a nice effort from the Arsenal midfielder.
Arsenal are encamped in the Fulham half and are putting the Cottagers under severe pressure.
SAVE! Arsenal are caught napping after Vieira handles the ball after he doesn't get a free-kick.
Traore is played behind the Arsenal defence and surges past Saliba, who puts in a desperate lunge and misses, only to see his effort blocked by Ramsdale.
Almost a winner at the death for the visitors.
SAVE! Vieira cuts inside from the right flank and bends a powerful strike on his foot at goal, but Leno holds firm and touches it over the top.
CLOSE! Nketiah heads the ball across the face of goal from Saka's corner.
It almost falls for Kiwior, but Diop reacts first and edges it away from the Arsenal man for another corner.
Tete is booked late on.
FULL-TIME: ARSENAL 2-2 FULHAM
Joao Palhinha's strike earned Fulham a share of the spoils in a 2-2 draw against Arsenal at the Emirates Stadium.
Andreas Pereira fired the visitors ahead after 57 seconds capitalising on a mistake from Bukayo Saka.
It took until after the break for Arsenal to respond as Saka scored from the penalty spot after Fabio Vieira was fouled in the box.
Eddie Nketiah then converted a cross from Vieira to put the Gunners ahead.
Calvin Bassey was then dismissed for the visitors for two bookable offences.
But, the Cottagers didn't give up and earned a valuable point as Palhinha swept home Harrison Reed's corner.
Arsenal face Manchester United in their next outing at home next Sunday.
Fulham are in EFL Cup against at home to Tottenham on Tuesday.
Thanks for joining our commentary today.
Until next time, goodbye.
